name: Geochem Base Profile
abstract: The geochemistry overlay on its own: the analytical surface this repository adds to, and refines on top of, the CDIF profiles -- analysis events, variables measured, distributions and parts, coverage, and the product-level declarations. geochemProduct is the composition of the CDIF profiles with this block; this block composes nothing and is not a standalone record schema.

sources.title: Factored out of geochemProduct, following the cdifProfile / cdifCompositeProfile split
